blind.description: A stylised wooden display table draped in a dark red cloth, heavily stocked with bakery items. The goods include several round crusty bread loaves, two woven baskets containing oblong bread rolls or miniature baguettes, a braided bread loaf, a woven tray filled with small dinner rolls, and a tall cylindrical frosted sweet bread or panettone with dripping white glaze. The wooden table features two trestle-style legs connected by a horizontal stretcher beam.
blind.from_above: A dense rectangular arrangement of baked goods on a red cloth with overhang edges; shows two large round loaves at the left, two baskets of elongated rolls, a braided bread loaf, a circular pan of round buns, and a round iced cake top at the upper right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.3 to 2.5 ft tall to top of goods), and about 4 to 4.5 ft long by 2.2 ft wide.
